{{Quote|Please let me go! I'm innocent. I didn't know cheating was a capital offense. I'll never do it again!|The prisoner pleading to Hovrak|<ref name="DA" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''prisoner''' had been convicted of cheating at [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. Unknown to the Sabacc player, cheating was a capital offense on Concord Dawn. A [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Unidentified Devaronian magistrate|magistrate]], in league with the [[Anti-Humanism|anti-human]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group known as the [[Diversity Alliance]], sent the prisoner to the group's headquarters on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] for [[Death/Legends|execution]]<ref name="DA" /> in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="TERC" /> He was [[Diet/Legends|eaten]] by the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] [[Hovrak]].<ref name="DA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The prisoner's voice appeared in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Diversity Alliance]]'', a [[1997]] young readers novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]].<ref name="DA" />
